hooks.command: FP=$(python3 -c "import sys,json; print(json.load(sys.stdin).get('tool_input',{}).get('file_path',''))"); case "$FP" in *tokens/*) npm run build ;; esac; exit 0

FP=$(python3 -c "import sys,json; print(json.load(sys.stdin).get('tool_input',{}).get('file_path',''))"); case "$FP" in *.css) M=$(grep -n ':focus[^-]' "$FP" 2>/dev/null) && { echo "Warning: use :focus-visible, not :focus:"; echo "$M"; } ;; esac; exit 0

git diff HEAD --name-only 2>/dev/null | grep -q 'tokens/' && ! git diff HEAD --name-only 2>/dev/null | grep -q 'CHANGELOG' && echo 'Reminder: tokens/ was modified — did you update CHANGELOG.md?'; exit 0
